text: Fever is a live-entertainment tech platform co-founded and led by three Spaniards, Ignacio Bachiller, Francisco Hein and Alexandre Perez; in September 2026 it raised $250 million in a round led by EQT with participation from Point72 Private Investments and Baillie Gifford.
short: Fever: co-founded and led by Ignacio Bachiller, Francisco Hein and Alexandre Perez.
